extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from local XML and supplementary PDF text. Docking is computational support only; MTT/plaque assays are phenotypic antiviral evidence, not direct molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The peptides reduced SARS-CoV-2 cytopathic effect in Vero E6 MTT assays and reduced plaque formation at tested fixed concentrations.
mechanism_claims.limitations: These assays support antiviral phenotype/neutralization, but do not directly identify a molecular mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Molecular docking predicted interactions between all four peptides and the SARS-CoV-2 spike D614G protein, with reported LBEI/RMSD and residue-interaction context.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Mo-CBP3-PepII, RcAlb-PepI, PepGAT, PepKAA interacting with S(D614G)
